title: tc-data-table
description: A database-style table that works like a small spreadsheet.

heading.description: The table's name: its heading and the grid's label

columns.description: The columns, left to right: each one's key, label, type, width and whether it can be edited

rows.description: The rows. Edits change them unless a tc-rows-change listener calls preventDefault()

sort.description: Sort; null shows the rows in their own order

tagTones.description: Tag colors by tag text – falls back to blue

readonly.description: Read only: no editing, adding or deleting; cell selection and copy still work, and the row checkboxes hide unless `selectable` is set

selectable.description: Whether rows have selection checkboxes; unset, they show unless the table is `readonly`

type.description: title: logo and name · tag: colored pill with a picker · link: underlined URL · number · text

editable.description: false makes the column read only – edits, pastes and clears skip it

options.description: Choices for a tag column – defaults to the tags already in the column

logo.description: Small logo in front of the title cell: an element (cloned) or an image URL
